scientific_depth.justification: The joint admission predicate, conditional deadline argument, epoch isolation, and physical coherency conditions are explicitly formulated and tied to measured evidence.

technical_execution.justification: Production paths, generation checks, fallback re-admission, and K230 integration are described concretely and supported by finite-domain experiments.

logical_flow.justification: The compiler-evidence-runtime narrative is clear, although the contract fields and evidence layers remain distributed across several sections.

writing_clarity.justification: Terminology is consistent and the negative timing result is stated precisely; two dense mechanism passages would benefit from compact summaries.

evidence_presentation.justification: All four figures are discussed, exact counts are tabulated, and software versus physical results are separated in prose.

academic_style.justification: The manuscript uses restrained IEEE systems-paper language and avoids unsupported superiority claims.
